long_biography.plain_text:
At WLEGAL, Belgian lawyer Grégory Guissard has advised private clients on cross-border acquisitions. When the shareholders of Mercantour Invest bought a property development before completion from Adim Côte d'Azur, he handled the Luxembourg aspects. His colleague Lionel Yvant covered the French side of the acquisition.

Guissard also worked on Trévise Participations' purchase of a majority stake in Videlio, alongside lawyers from Hogan Lovells. The audiovisual group's activities included workplace technology, live events and entertainment systems for cruise ships. The transaction brought in a new controlling investor while the existing investor Hivest retained a minority position.
